script: Welcome to Pratham One Edu O-S, your institute command centre. Live academic, attendance, and fee insights bring the day into focus.
badge_subtitle: A live view of institute performance

script: Find every learner in one trusted student directory. Search profiles, review enrolments, and follow each student's journey.
Guide each enquiry from first contact to admission with a clear, organised pipeline. Keep follow-ups and prospective learners in view.
Track fee collections, outstanding balances, and payment activity in one place. Clear analytics help your team understand every inflow.
Review concession and waiver requests through a governed workflow. Each approved benefit stays connected to its student and financial record.
badge_subtitle: Governed requests and clear audit trails

script: See academy and sponsor-funded scholarships alongside the wider fee picture. Keep student benefits visible without losing financial clarity.
Follow daily attendance, monthly registers, and absence alerts from one workspace. The U-P-I Q-R terminal makes check-in quick and traceable.
badge_subtitle: Daily registers and U-P-I Q-R check-in

script: Build clear weekly schedules for classes, rooms, and faculty. Give teachers and students a dependable view of what comes next.
badge_subtitle: Weekly schedules for classes and faculty

script: Organise exam schedules, question papers, and marks in a single workflow. Keep assessment activity consistent across every class.
Review class performance and prepare clear student report cards. Share verified results with confidence and consistent grading.
Keep staff profiles, responsibilities, attendance, and leave records together. Give your institute team a dependable people directory.
Coordinate notices, message templates, and communication history from one workspace. Keep institute updates organised across channels.
Turn academic, attendance, and financial activity into useful reports. Explore operational insights and prepare data for export.
Manage institute preferences, access controls, and workspace configuration in one central area. Clear settings help your team work consistently.
Organise course materials, notes, question banks, and learning resources. Keep teaching content discoverable for the whole institute.
badge_subtitle: A shared library for teaching resources

script: Keep assignments, submissions, and checking activity together. Teachers can follow homework progress from assignment to review.
Bring lessons to life on the Digital Whiteboard and Greenboard. Present classroom ideas with a flexible, interactive teaching space.
Prepare consistent admission forms, identity cards, and academic documents. Preview print-ready materials before sharing them.
badge_subtitle: Preview forms, identity cards, and records

script: Move institute data through guided import and export tools. Review templates and job status before handling a data exchange.
badge_subtitle: Guided data exchange and job tracking
